source: Hand-verified from in-game screenshots of anatomy_atlas_5x5_sub.dds (2026-05-22).
notes: Each cell's bbox is in 4096-canvas coords (x0, y0, x1, y1).
When resolving a tattoo at 2048-canvas, scale up by 2x first, OR use normalized [0,1] coords.
Consistent rule: canvas X < cell_midpoint -> character's RIGHT anatomy; X >= midpoint -> character's LEFT.
D3 horizontal midline (absolute y=2867) passes THROUGH the nipples.
Navel sits at the D3/E3 boundary (y=3277). ALL of E3 is BELOW the navel — E3a/E3b are just below navel, E3c/E3d are pubic-mound region.
C3 covers both shoulder blades plus nape. Logical L/R subdivision (C3-left, C3-right) added by canvas-X pattern but not separately color-marked in the atlas texture.
Back UV inverts: canvas-A row (y=0-819) = lower back / buttocks; canvas-B row = mid-back; canvas-C row = upper back / shoulder blades / nape. So canvas-up != body-up for the back half.

subdivisions.D3: central chest — split a/b/c/d at row/col midpoints
subdivisions.A3: buttock cheeks + sacrum — split a/b/c/d at row/col midpoints
subdivisions.E3: lower abdomen / pubic + L/R hip — split a/b/c/d at row/col midpoints

upper arm inner / lateral upper torso
upper shoulder region — front (collarbone/chest near shoulder) AND back (shoulder blade, nape)
cells.note: wraps the shoulder ring around the body; split logically by canvas-X for L/R

left upper-outer thigh / left lower-buttock fold
right upper-outer thigh / right hip-thigh junction
lower abdomen just below navel, right side
lower abdomen just below navel, left side

pubic mound / left hip / very low abdomen
